items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: I know you heard talk about Peter Lauer when he had a show on Claymore Street

ctx.x: You were talking about Sidney that day.

Bechet, yeah. Now Sidney Bechet, the first clarinet was a Christmas gift, see? And he picked up, now I can't tell you, I don't think Bechet ever took less than one on the clarinet, because he didn't know how to read, you know? But boy, he's going to play clarinet. And you know what Bechet used to do? Bechet used to, I know you heard talk about Peter Lauer when he had a show on Claymore Street, between Cori and St. Louis, you remember that? Peter Lauer had that. Well Bechet was a fella, he liked it a bit. And you…
Oh, by the way to interrupt, I've tried to look up that name to see, to write it down, that Rishack or whatever it is, how, do you know how that's spelled?
